name: Gennai
description:
The night porter, pushing the tea trolley down Ward Four squeaking on its wheels, as he has every night for longer than anyone remembers. Pours for whoever is awake, and talks while he pours. Old, long-serving, quietly one of the better-informed people on the island without meaning to be -- porters and nurses hear what the hospital is told to make ready for before anyone else does, and Gennai in particular knows how many beds and when, though never what for.

Tonight he's grumbling: the office has told the hospital to have twenty extra beds made up by the end of the week, and nobody's told him why. 'Last time they asked for extra beds was the spring drill. Three broken legs and a lad who walked into a crane. The hospital always knows before you lot do.'

If a character gets lost wandering the old department-store corridors at night, he's the one who finds them among the linen and walks them back -- delighted.
designNotes:
Created 2026-09-29, extracted from canon/scenes/rest--general-hospital.json -- but unlike tsubaki/imai/aucourt, he was never given a full cast entry with his own voice/attitude/doors block; he only exists in the prose of two events (the-tea-trolley, lost-in-the-store) and the twenty-extra-beds setback. This file, and his new cast entry in the scene, are genuinely thinner than his ward-mates' for that reason -- nothing padded out to make him look more finished than the source material actually is. Kept as written, no ancestry twist (Ingram, 2026-09-29): 'It's fine for some characters to be stubs, it leaves them as characters to build upon later.'

His cast entry needed creating from scratch, not just an npcRef added to an existing one (his id `gennai` didn't exist in the scene's cast array at all before now) -- walkOn: true, matching the schema's own 'someone deliberately disposable' framing, though Ingram chose to give him art anyway.

No socialProfile authored: the source gives him no explicit attitude, no doors, no coercible/reveal mechanism -- nothing to extract into one without inventing it.
status: established and voiced, but thin by design (a stub, not a regular) -- fourth General Hospital haunt NPC formalized into a real npc file
